name: comp-387
title: Share Link Popover
blurb: Popover for sharing content via link or social platforms.
description: A shadcn Popover with social sharing buttons (Twitter, Facebook, Email, Embed) and a copy-to-clipboard link field.
use_when: Allowing users to share content to social media or copy a shareable link without navigating away.
avoid_when: When you need to track social shares or integrate with third-party analytics — button clicks are display-only.
a11y: Social buttons have aria-labels; copy button aria-labeled; tooltip uses TooltipProvider; input is aria-labeled; full keyboard support.
